description: The setup screen shows real loading progress for each step instead of using a fake timer
steps: Start the AI agent and the cloud browser at the same time so the user doesn't wait twice
List 'Connecting the AI agent' first since it finishes fastest, followed by 'Allocating cloud browser', 'Opening google.com', and 'Starting the live view' so steps check off from top to bottom
Check off each browser step only as the backend actually finishes it (session created, Google loaded, live view ready)
Only open the demo screen once all four steps are actually finished
If any step fails during setup, show the error right away with a 'Try again' button

description: The agent introduces itself as Alex, asks for the visitor's name, and uses it in conversation
steps: Introduce the agent as Alex in the opening greeting and ask for the visitor's name
Use the visitor's name naturally throughout the conversation once they share it
If the visitor asks to search before giving their name, run the search first and ask for their name when sharing the results

description: The agent actively leads and sells the Google Search experience instead of acting like a passive search bar
steps: Guide the conversation and pitch why live Google Search is fast, clear, and effortless
After each search, highlight the top one or two visible results and suggest a smart follow-up search to try next
Keep all claims strictly about Google Search and what is visible on screen without inventing Fastbreak product details or clicking into result links

description: The agent speaks an explanation while Playwright is typing and loading Google Search results
steps: Before calling the searchGoogle tool, speak two sentences explaining what query is being typed and what the visitor should watch for on the live screen
Play that explanation audio while Playwright runs in the background so there is no awkward silence

description: Show a clear loading state and prevent the user from interrupting while Playwright is running a search
steps: Set the searchGoogle tool to disable user interruptions while the search and follow-up turn are running
Change the agent status badge to 'Searching' and show a spinner with the active search query in both the browser bar and the chat window
Disable the chat input and Send button with a 'Browser search in progress' notice until the search finishes

description: The agent proactively talks to the visitor when 1 minute is left on the demo timer
steps: When the timer reaches 1:00 left, trigger the agent to speak without adding a visible user message bubble in the chat
Wait until any active search or agent reply finishes before triggering the 1-minute check-in
Have the agent mention that one minute is left, briefly recap what was searched, and offer one final search or question

description: Show clickable starter prompts before the first search so visitors know what to try
steps: Render clickable starter prompt buttons under the opening greeting when no searches have been run yet
Send the selected prompt immediately when clicked and hide the chips once a search starts

description: Tell the ElevenLabs agent when the visitor is typing so it waits instead of talking over them
steps: Call sendUserActivity on the active ElevenLabs session whenever the visitor types into the chat input
